fields.statement: At 5a20f3f8 I read the diff: internal/guide/text/import.md step 4 now states the load-bearing rule (bring in only a decision that shapes a capability or constraint) and the exact wording form '<as the document states it>, made autonomously by the agent and not confirmed by the owner', with no quote field and a derived-from link to the document's Source.
